description: List the user's saved searches: each one's saved_search_id, name, target roles, locations, whether new-match email alerts are on, when it was created and when it last sent an alert. A saved search is a named snapshot of the job preferences. Read-only: it changes nothing and spends no credits. Do not use it to see jobs; use getmattered_get_matches. Next: getmattered_get_matches for the jobs that match now.
name: getmattered_list_saved_searches

action.description: The operation that ran: list, save, update or delete.

deletedId.description: From getmattered_delete_saved_search: the search that was deleted.

alertsEnabled.description: True when new matches for this search are emailed to the user.

savedSearchId.description: Pass as saved_search_id to getmattered_update_saved_search or getmattered_delete_saved_search.

saved.description: From getmattered_create_saved_search or getmattered_update_saved_search: the search after the change.

title: List Saved Searches
